backend: Official AOSP API 29 x86, Android emulator 37.2.13, TCG, scrcpy 5.0.1 Wayland virtual display
input_method: wlr virtual pointer -> compositor normal cursor/seat handlers -> scrcpy Wayland window -> Android input
limitations: One x86 application on Android 10; arbitrary applications and ARM translation unverified.
The launcher redirects to display 0; open-window.py waited for display 3 and relocated the unique app task, then host-pointer calculation was verified again.
Clipboard, file integration, repeated cold-start reliability, and near-native performance remain unverified.
Headless compositor used the explicitly compiled OLYMPIUM_TEST_INPUT variant.
close_method: Host pointer: File menu > Close Window; scrcpy exited 0, open-window.py recorded closed
